hook: At the subatomic scale, playing the movie of physics backwards usually makes complete sense.
narration: At the subatomic scale, playing the movie of physics backwards usually makes complete sense. If you film two particles colliding, the reversed footage follows the exact same laws of motion. For most fundamental forces, nature does not care which way the clock ticks. But there is a twist. The weak nuclear force actually breaks this rule. It treats forward and backward time differently. Even at the particle level, nature has a subtle arrow of time. The clock only truly runs one way.
